Chapter 6861: What Power Is This?

Chapter 6861: What Power Is This?

“Could the whole alliance have worked together?” Thunder Emperor asked.

“Hard to say. Mang’s death happened before Heaven Pit, Zhao Dachui took charge afterward. Obtaining the corpse would have been a pivotal moment and established their authority. It would have been publicized.” The bear said.

“Right, never heard of this before.” She agreed. After pondering briefly, she asked: “How about Immortal Emperor Gu Chun?”

“Good question.” The bear said: “The emperor has a special relationship with Devouring Alliance, he doesn’t need to prove anything like the others. Moreover, he established his own sect during the alliance’s decline.”

“Right.” She said.

Dark Realm under Immortal Emperor Gu Chun was in charge of Stygian. This lineage could compete with all others in the nine major worlds.

He suppressed Fallen Ten and forced them to obey. In a sense, he had to tower over them to exert his dominance.

“Who can it be, if not the alliance?” Thunder stared at the shadow beneath.

“The corpse would make a fine weapon, but whoever can get it does not need such a weapon.” Li Qiye said.

“Perhaps there is another use for it.” The bear said.

“Whatever, it’s just a corpse.” Li Qiye didn’t dwell on this matter and moved on.

The two hurried after him since without his protection, the snow-white slash would instantly kill them.

However, there was nothing once they got through the slash. This emptiness was strange because normally, even the absence of tangible things still had various affinities.

Nothing described the area before them - no space, time, karma, or the dao. Anything that could be felt by cultivators was absent.

“What is going on here?” Thunder looked back and only saw the white slash.

In theory, Immortal Emperor Min Ren might have stood where they were to perform the slash.

“Hmm, nothing is here.” The bear used his power and sensed nothing.

“This might be Mang’s ultimate attack, Hollow. Everything was consumed.” Li Qiye said.

“Hollow.” The two imagined the power of this frightening technique.

There seemed to be an invisible wall before them because nothing was there. However, Li Qiye was able to walk inside.

It should be impossible to walk into a non-existent sphere. This was akin to creation - something not available to immortals.

The bear understood the significance of this and needed a moment to regain his composure.

“This is so strange.” The emperor remarked while sensing this area.

They felt as if they were disappearing, not leaving anything behind. This was different from devouring. After all, the devourer would have a full stomach afterward. There would be some remnant factors of the devoured left behind in one way or another.
